pages.text: The $(item)Unpackager/$ unpackages sets of $(l:core/package)Recipe Packages/$ into adjacent inventories or $(thing)package crafting machines/$ depending on the $(thing)recipe type/$.$(p)This machine requires power.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: To use the $(item)Unpackager/$, put sets of $(l:core/package)Recipe Packages/$ inside. The packages will be inserted into $(thing)trackers/$, and when filled, packages will be unpackaged into adjacent adjacent inventories or $(thing)package crafting machines/$ depending on the $(thing)recipe type/$. You may change the number of trackers.

pages.title: Usage (cont.)
pages.text: For processing recipes, you can enable $(thing)blocking mode/$, which prevents unpackaging into occupied inventories.$(p)You may extract inputs out from the top side.

pages.title: Settings Cloning
pages.text: Using the $(l:core/settings_cloner)Packaging Settings Cloner/$, you can copy and paste the blocking mode setting, the tracker count setting, and the current available recipes.$(p)To paste recipes, the target $(item)Unpackager/$ should not have recipes, and you must have an empty $(l:core/recipe_holder)Package Recipe Holder/$ in your inventory.

pages.title: AE2 Integration
pages.text: The $(item)Unpackager/$ can be connected to an $(thing)ME Network/$, requiring a channel.$(p)It will extract power to use and provide unpackaging as autocrafting.$(p)Place an encoded $(l:core/recipe_holder)Package Recipe Holder/$ inside to allow the provide unpackaging autocrafting for the encoded recipes.
